title: Isaiah Chapter 19 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Isaiah chapter 19 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Isaiah Chapter 19 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Isaiah Chapter 19.

questions.question: What does the LORD ride upon when He comes into Egypt?
questions.explanation: The LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, as stated in Isaiah 19:1.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 19, what will happen to the heart of Egypt?
questions.explanation: The heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it, as mentioned in Isaiah 19:1.

questions.question: Who will the Egyptians fight against according to Isaiah 19:2?
questions.explanation: The Egyptians shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour, as stated in Isaiah 19:2.

questions.question: True or False: The spirit of Egypt will succeed in its plans.
questions.explanation: The spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof, as stated in Isaiah 19:3.

questions.question: What will happen to the rivers and brooks in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up, as mentioned in Isaiah 19:5.

questions.question: True or False: The Egyptians will seek help from their idols.
questions.explanation: They shall seek to the idols, as stated in Isaiah 19:3.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 19:4, who will rule over Egypt?
questions.explanation: A fierce king shall rule over them, as stated in Isaiah 19:4.

questions.question: What will happen to the fishers in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The fishers also shall mourn, as mentioned in Isaiah 19:8.

questions.question: True or False: The princes of Zoan are considered wise according to Isaiah 19.
questions.explanation: The princes of Zoan are fools, as stated in Isaiah 19:11.

questions.question: In Isaiah 19, what comes first in the sequence of events?
options: The heart of Egypt shall melt
The Egyptians will fight each other
The wise men of Pharaoh will be confounded
questions.correctAnswer: The heart of Egypt shall melt
questions.explanation: The heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it, as stated in Isaiah 19:1, which occurs before the other events.

questions.question: What will be said about the Egyptians in the day of the LORD?
questions.explanation: The LORD shall be known to Egypt, as stated in Isaiah 19:21.

questions.question: What will happen to the Egyptians according to Isaiah 19:22?
questions.explanation: The LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it, as mentioned in Isaiah 19:22.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 19:19, what will be established in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, as stated in Isaiah 19:19.

medium.title: Isaiah Chapter 19 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Isaiah Chapter 19 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What will happen to the idols of Egypt at the presence of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:1 states that the idols of Egypt shall be moved at the presence of the Lord, indicating their impotence compared to God's power.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 19, what will the Egyptians do to each other?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:2 reveals that the Egyptians will be set against each other, indicating internal conflict and strife.

questions.question: What will happen to the spirit of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:3 states that the spirit of Egypt shall fail, signifying a loss of hope and direction.

questions.question: In Isaiah 19, who will rule over the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:4 mentions that God will give the Egyptians over into the hand of a cruel lord, emphasizing the severity of their punishment.

questions.question: What will happen to the waters in Egypt according to Isaiah 19?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:5 states that the waters shall fail from the sea and the river shall be wasted and dried up, symbolizing God's judgment.

questions.question: How will the Egyptians react to the troubles they face according to Isaiah 19?
options: They will seek idols and charmers
questions.correctAnswer: They will seek idols and charmers
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:3 indicates that they will seek to the idols and charmers instead of turning to God for help.

questions.question: What is said about the princes of Zoan in Isaiah 19?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:11 declares that the princes of Zoan are fools, highlighting their lack of wisdom in their counsel to Pharaoh.

questions.question: True or False: The Egyptians will be able to work effectively during the judgment described in Isaiah 19.
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:15 states that there shall be no work for Egypt, indicating their inability to carry out their tasks during this time of distress.

questions.question: In that day, what will the Egyptians fear according to Isaiah 19?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:16 explains that Egypt shall be afraid because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts.

questions.question: True or False: Egypt will have no fear of Judah according to Isaiah 19.
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:17 states that the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, showing that they will indeed fear it.

questions.question: What significant change will occur in five cities of Egypt according to Isaiah 19?
options: They will speak the language of Canaan
questions.correctAnswer: They will speak the language of Canaan
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:18 indicates that five cities in Egypt will begin to speak the language of Canaan, symbolizing a transformation.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 19:20 promise after the Egyptians cry unto the LORD?
options: He will send them a saviour
He will keep them in bondage
questions.correctAnswer: He will send them a saviour
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:20 promises that the LORD will send them a saviour after they cry out because of their oppressors.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD will only smite Egypt without healing them according to Isaiah 19.
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:22 reveals that the LORD will smite Egypt and also heal it, indicating restoration after judgment.

questions.question: What will happen in that day regarding the relationship between Egypt, Assyria, and Israel according to Isaiah 19?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:24 states that in that day Israel will be the third with Egypt and Assyria, indicating a united blessing.

questions.question: How does Isaiah 19 teach us about humility?
options: It shows the power of pride
It demonstrates the need for reliance on God
questions.correctAnswer: It demonstrates the need for reliance on God
questions.explanation: The chapter illustrates that the Egyptians will face judgment and realize their need for God, teaching us the importance of humility and reliance on Him.

hard.title: Isaiah Chapter 19 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Isaiah Chapter 19.

questions.question: What shall be established in the midst of the land of Egypt in that day?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:19 states, 'In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt,' indicating the establishment of an altar.

questions.question: What shall the Egyptians do in that day according to Isaiah 19:21?
options: Vow a vow unto the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Vow a vow unto the LORD
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:21 reveals that the Egyptians shall 'do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD.'

questions.question: What does the LORD promise to send to Egypt because of their oppressors?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:20 states that the LORD 'shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.'

questions.question: In Isaiah 19:22, what actions does the LORD take towards Egypt?
options: He shall smite and heal it
questions.correctAnswer: He shall smite and heal it
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:22 states, 'And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it,' indicating a dual action of judgment and restoration.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 19:24, who will be with Egypt and Assyria in that day?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:24 mentions that 'Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria,' highlighting a future unity among these nations.

questions.question: Which city is mentioned as 'The city of destruction' in Isaiah 19:18?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:18 specifies that one of the five cities shall be called 'The city of destruction,' indicating a significant transformation.

questions.question: What literary device is primarily used in Isaiah 19:14 where Egypt is compared to a drunken man?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:14 uses metaphor to describe Egypt's state of confusion and disorder by comparing it to a drunken man staggering.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 19:23 prophesy about relations between Egypt and Assyria?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:23 foretells a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, symbolizing restored relations and cooperation between the nations.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 19:17 states that the land of Judah will be a terror to Egypt.
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:17 states, 'And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt,' indicating fear due to the counsel of the LORD.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 19:15 indicates that there will be much work for Egypt to do.
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:15 states, 'Neither shall there be any work for Egypt,' indicating a time of disruption and lack of labor.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the theme of the saviour sent to deliver the people, as mentioned in Isaiah 19:20?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:21 states, 'For he shall save his people from their sins,' reflecting the promise of a saviour in Isaiah 19:20.

questions.question: Which passage in the Old Testament speaks of Egypt being blessed, similar to Isaiah 19:25?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:27 speaks of the eventual restoration and blessing of Egypt, mirroring Isaiah 19:25's affirmation of Egypt's blessed status.

questions.question: Which Hebrew term for 'saviour' is used in Isaiah 19:20 and can also mean 'deliverer'?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term 'Yasha' in Isaiah 19:20 translates to 'saviour' or 'deliverer,' indicating God's role in providing salvation.

theological.title: Isaiah Chapter 19 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Isaiah Chapter 19 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What is indicated by the phrase 'the burden of Egypt' in Isaiah 19:1?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'the burden of Egypt' signifies a prophetic warning about impending judgment and calamity that God will bring upon Egypt, as indicated in Isaiah 19:1.

questions.question: What happens to the idols of Egypt when the LORD comes?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:1 states that 'the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence', indicating that they will not withstand the power of the LORD.

questions.question: What consequence does Isaiah 19:2 describe for the Egyptians?
options: They will fight against each other
They will flee from their land
questions.correctAnswer: They will fight against each other
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:2 foretells that the Egyptians will be set against each other, leading to internal conflict and strife.

questions.question: In Isaiah 19:4, who will rule over the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:4 indicates that the Egyptians will be given over to 'a cruel lord', signifying harsh and oppressive leadership as a judgment from God.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 19:6, what will happen to the rivers in Egypt?
options: They will be filled with fish
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:6 prophesies that 'the rivers shall turn far away', indicating a severe drought and environmental disaster.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 19:10 reveal about the future of those who make sluices and ponds for fish?
options: They shall be broken in their purposes
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be broken in their purposes
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:10 states that those who make sluices and ponds for fish will be 'broken in the purposes thereof', indicating that their efforts will come to nothing.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 19:14 say about the spirit of Egypt?
options: It will be mingled with a perverse spirit
questions.correctAnswer: It will be mingled with a perverse spirit
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:14 reveals that the LORD has mingled 'a perverse spirit' within Egypt, leading to confusion and error in their actions.

questions.question: In Isaiah 19:19, what will be established in the midst of the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:19 prophesies that 'there shall be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt', signifying a return to worship of the true God.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 19:20 indicate will happen when the Egyptians cry unto the LORD?
options: He shall send them a saviour
questions.correctAnswer: He shall send them a saviour
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:20 states that when the Egyptians cry out due to oppression, the LORD will 'send them a saviour', indicating God's provision for deliverance.

questions.question: In Isaiah 19:25, how does the LORD refer to Egypt and Assyria?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:25 shows that the LORD declares 'Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands', emphasizing His redemptive purpose for these nations.

questions.question: What attribute of God is demonstrated in Isaiah 19:22 when the LORD heals Egypt?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:22 illustrates God's mercy as He smites and heals Egypt, showing His willingness to restore and forgive despite their rebellion.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 19:17 say about the land of Judah in relation to Egypt?
options: It will be united with Egypt
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:17 states that 'the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt', indicating that the Egyptians will fear the power and counsel of the LORD.

questions.question: In Isaiah 19:23, what significant change is prophesied for the relationship between Egypt and Assyria?
options: They will have a highway between them
questions.correctAnswer: They will have a highway between them
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:23 prophesies a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, indicating a future reconciliation and cooperation between these nations.

questions.question: What does the combination of Isaiah 19:12 and 19:13 teach about the leaders of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:12 mentions the wise men of Egypt failing to understand God's purpose, and verse 13 states that the princes of Noph are deceived, indicating the folly and confusion of Egypt's leaders.

questions.question: What does the combination of Isaiah 19:5 and 19:6 reveal about the environmental conditions in Egypt?
options: They will face drought and desolation
They will be abundant in resources
questions.correctAnswer: They will face drought and desolation
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:5 and 19:6 together reveal that the waters will fail and rivers will turn away, indicating severe drought and desolation in Egypt's environment.
